headline: 'Nova Poshta', Rozetka and ATB on the brink of stopping: consequences of Russian attacks on Ukrainian business revealed
summary: Systemically important Ukrainian companies including Nova Poshta, Rozetka and ATB face possible shutdowns, with losses in the billions reported. The losses stem from Russian attacks on Ukrainian business.
why: Nova Poshta is a major parcel carrier, Rozetka an online retailer and ATB a leading supermarket chain, so their disruption affects logistics, e-commerce and food retail in Ukraine.
